name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.service.ReceiveCallMessageService
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this service for a signed-in account to listen for call and logout messages. It opens the incoming-call screen for a new call and returns to sign-in after a logout.
disableEffect: Incoming calls and logout messages can no longer open their required screens, disrupting the Remote Cooperation call and account flows.
